item.title: Ravi Teja’s ‘Irumudi’ lands in trouble as teachers’ federation objects to school scenes
item.summary: Following its debut, the Telugu film 'Irumudi' has stirred controversy. The Andhra Pradesh Teachers Federation is voicing concerns over specific scenes, alleging that they unfavorably depict government schools and educators. In response, the federation has demanded the filmmakers cut these scenes and issue an apology. As of now, the team behind 'Irumudi' has not provided any public comment regarding these claims.
